implementations.native: Core category APIs + copy_helper + actual asynchronous_copy_task

matched_policy: One isolated copy-worker PHP process/method/run; sequential exact owned tasks, not parallel execution.
primary_endpoint: Preparation launch through own postprocessing exit; excludes verification, source hashing and cleanup.
settings_policy: Unmodified production defaults; users/keptroles disabled. Optional flags differ, so no engine-controlled or universally equivalent-settings claim.
oracle: Course/section/module design fields and design file SHA256; learner interactions/grades excluded; grade structure generated by restore allowed. Scope warnings make performance-summary eligibility false.
cleanup: Common core API harness with final postprocessing-complete ownership guards, not a plugin-native rollback comparison.
statistics: Paired counterbalanced blocks; warmups retained but excluded from summaries; no outlier removal; 10000 paired bootstrap resamples; n<2 CI unavailable; shared-host within-session intervals only.
unmeasured: DB server CPU and physical I/O
